title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1982-02-20
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/6th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji FeCr Tape/Dolby DB)

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑captured audience tape of a high‑energy February ’82 Golden Hall show with smoking To Lay Me Down, Let It Grow and an epic Franklin’s Tower → Samson transition.
ai_review.review: The recording, captured by Rango Keshavan and mastered by Miller, conveys the live essence despite being a bit warm and cloudy, with Jerry Garcia front‑and‑center and Brent Mydland slightly recessed. Musically the band is on fire – the first set delivers a superb To Lay Me Down and Let It Grow, while the second set opens with the rare Franklin’s Tower into Samson and builds into an unforgettable Playing in the Band jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviews rate the show 5 stars, praising both performance and tape quality; only one low rating exists, so the combined show‑and‑recording score is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, slightly cloudy tape but clear enough to hear all instruments; Brent’s keyboards are a bit low in the mix, Jerry sits prominently forward. Miller transfer is praised as immaculate.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band (jam into drums)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows burst out of the gate, maintain momentum throughout; rare Franklin’s opening leads smoothly into Samson and a tight second‑set jam sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as 'playing like a God' with his tone front‑and‑center; many reviewers highlight his exceptional performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as less punchy due to 1982 throwaway Jazz basses, but still solid foundation for the high‑energy set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s solo jam after Playing in the Band praised, though some mention his piano is low in the mix and the Yamaha electric piano tone was weaker than earlier years.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming receives praise especially during the extended Playing in the Band jam; rhythms are tight and drive the second‑set energy.
